digest.component_or_area: Jira family reconciler rich-text codec and sync layer
propositions: Cloud target requires bidirectional Markdown↔ADF codec with structured ADF encoding routed through production send/fit/compare paths, backed by marklas as a pinned optional extra with lazy import.

Data Center target requires one-way Markdown→wiki renderer with segmenting safe units, ASCII table wrapping, pandoc fallback on timeout/missing/pathological input, and configurable timeout via reconciler.dc_pandoc_timeout_s.

Echo-safety mechanism uses ADR-0026 per-binding baseline plus normalize_outbound with change-gated rich_sha to detect concurrent edits via three-way comparison and suppress unchanged second passes while preserving Jira-native constructs (panels, mentions, dates) through origin-gating.
Comment sync uses append-only local-to-Jira-ID mapping routed through the same rich-text codec as descriptions, capturing returned IDs on create/update without syncing edits or deletes.

Live cutover must verify DC rendered HTML via expand=renderedFields, Cloud ADF idempotence over committed corpus, zero monotonic length decay over five passes, and conflict safety against concurrent edits on both targets.
